working: Traffic more than doubled month over month: 1,158 sessions in the last 30 days (07-21 to 08-19) vs 553 in the prior 30 (+109%), and the 1,100-day window now totals 32,529 sessions.
Organic Search grew 39.1% period over period (225 -> 313 sessions) and holds 33.1% of the full window (10,772 of 32,529), keeping SEO the strongest earned channel.

GSC over the trailing 30 days shows 4,126 impressions, 53 clicks and an impression-weighted average position of 14.19 across 90 pages - a real presence to convert, since most of those pages sit just off page one.

The newsletter program is back: the Constant Contact connection is fixed (both the OAuth client secret and a separate stats-endpoint bug in the pull script are resolved as of today), and the August Alumni cycle sent on schedule - 08-13, 08-16 (reminder), and 08-19 (day-of), each landing 43-50% open on ~1,040 sends.

The Alumni list remains the healthiest audience on file: Alumni eNews - July 2026 (07-09) posted a 57.3% open on 1,028 sends with +77.2% session lift, and the 07-16 reminder held 46.77% open with the best recent click rate at 1.06%.
Open rates are not the problem anywhere: 51.17% average across all 114 tracked campaigns, far above the 25-35% health/nonprofit benchmark.
not_working: UTM leakage remains total. Newsletter links still carry no utm_source/utm_medium, so GA4 files newsletter clicks under Direct instead of Email - this was true before the OAuth break and is unaffected by today's fix. Fix it on the next send or the August Alumni sends will be just as invisible in GA4 as everything before them.

Session-lift correlation for the three new August sends (08-13, 08-16, 08-19) isn't computed yet - that requires a fresh GA4 pull alongside the Constant Contact one, which hasn't run since these sends went out. Treat the newsletter-engagement chart as incomplete for early-to-mid August until that catches up.

The August Alumni sends' click rates are on the low side so far (1.8%, 1.1%, 1.8% on Day Of/Reminder/Main respectively) versus the 07-09 send's stronger 1.06%+ pattern - worth watching whether this is noise or a real dip once lift data fills in.
Click rates are weak list-wide historically: 1.99% average across all tracked sends, and a meaningful share of 2026 sends have produced negative session lift in prior months.
Organic Social fell 22.6% period over period (31 -> 24 sessions) and is only 5.3% of the window - the smallest contribution of any owned channel BCC actively works.
do_next: Tag every link in the next send with ?utm_source=constantcontact&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=<send-name>. This is now the single highest-value fix remaining - until it ships, all newsletter credit keeps landing in Direct and email ROI cannot be argued, even with the data pipeline itself now working.

Re-run the GA4 + Constant Contact pull together so the 08-13/08-16/08-19 sends get session-lift numbers instead of showing as pending - right now the dashboard knows these sends happened but can't yet say whether they moved traffic.
Keep the September Alumni cadence on schedule (Day Of / Reminder / Main drafts already exist in Constant Contact) - don't let the list go dark again now that the connection is restored.
Send Tuesday or Wednesday, not Monday/Thursday/weekend: 2026 sends average +40.6% lift on Tuesday and +27.4% on Wednesday versus -2.0% Monday, -3.8% Thursday and -32.2% Saturday.

Repromote event-driven content - it is the only theme that has ever driven real clicks (Client eNews December(2) at 10.17% click / 19.35% click-to-open; 2024 Alumni Events November at 4.80% click, +64.7% lift).
Work the near-page-one SEO pages: with average position 14.19 and 4,126 impressions against only 53 clicks, title/meta rewrites on the top impression pages are the cheapest click gain available.
Audit the Direct spike (209 -> 735 sessions, +251.7%) with no newsletter sent in that window - confirm it is real demand and not bot or referral-stripped traffic before crediting it to marketing.
summary: The Constant Contact connection is fixed as of 2026-08-20 (both a stale OAuth secret and a separate stats-API bug in the pull script), and the dashboard now reflects reality: the August Alumni cycle sent on 08-13, 08-16, and 08-19 as planned, not a 31-day-dark list as previously shown. Site traffic more than doubled month over month to 1,158 sessions, led by a +251.7% Direct surge and +39.1% Organic Search. The next highest-value fix is UTM tagging on newsletter links - GA4 still can't distinguish email clicks from Direct traffic, so email's real contribution to that traffic surge is unmeasured either way.
